# Inspection Reference

Every inspection the server registers, with the diagnostic codes it reports.
Configure them in `.config/shopware/lsp.yaml` (see the
[reference](reference.md)): `diagnostics.inspections.<id>` switches an
inspection, `diagnostics.rules.<code>` sets a code's severity. Suppress a code
on one line with an `@noinspection <code>` comment.

<!-- Generated by crates/app/src/tests/inspection_reference_test.rs from the
inspection registry; edit the inspection definitions, then regenerate with
SHOPWARE_LSP_UPDATE_REFERENCE=1 cargo test -p swlsp-app inspection_reference -->

## `php.imports`

Reports `use` imports nothing in the file refers to.

Languages: php. Domain: `php`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `php.unusedImport` | hint | yes |
